comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Behavior specs (Gherkin, red before implementation):**

Feature: botspy scan
  `botspy scan` mines the adapters into the local store — the CDC pass behind the store, on the command line. Default: every registered source into the one store at $BOTSPY_HOME/.botspy/store.db. The pass adds new sessions and updates changed ones; it never prunes (an adapter reporting 0 must never delete stored history — bug BOTSPY-81143b). Exit codes: 0 success, 1 unknown source, 2 usage error, 3 store failure.

  Scenario: A default scan fills the store from every source (12 fixture sessions added of 13 discovered; dry run leaves the store empty)
  Scenario: `--source` scans a single adapter; repeated `--source` scans a list
  Scenario: `--since <RFC3339|YYYY-MM-DD|7d>` cuts off what the pass picks up (skipped counted, nothing older deleted)
  Scenario: `--store <path>` overrides the store path; the default honors $BOTSPY_HOME
  Scenario: `--dry-run` reports what would change and writes nothing
  Scenario: `-o json` serializes the per-adapter report; ndjson streams one entry per source
  Scenario: An adapter reporting 0 sessions shows its zero row visibly (codex under bug BOTSPY-81143b must never hide)
  Scenario: Unknown source exits 1; bad `--since` exits 2; unusable store exits 3

Store-level specs (features/02_querying/05_ingest.feature, 06_refresh.feature): cutoff `since` on the ingest and refresh passes; skipped sessions counted; dry-run passes roll back; per-adapter detailed report.

Full feature files land in features/cli/60_scan.feature and the two 02_querying files.
